GENUINE ENGINE GAP, checked and confirmed, NOT closed by this task: 'at least four mana was spent to cast it' has NO tracking mechanism anywhere in this engine — grepped functional-model/*.ts for manaSpent/spentMana/totalManaSpent/'mana spent': zero hits. This is a STRICTLY DEEPER gap than the already-documented CardDefinition.cmc pool-wide opt-in-field gap (Phoenix Down, 2026-09-12): even a fully-populated `cmc` field would only approximate 'mana spent' (a spell's real mana value), not the literal amount of mana a player chose to spend paying for it, which can exceed mana value via kicker/additional/alternative costs — CR 601.2h/706 territory this engine has zero machinery for. Modeled the `cmc:{min:4}` constraint on the sink's target anyway (same 'correctness over match count' precedent Phoenix Down's own cmc:{max:4} already set) — currently unsatisfiable pool-wide (no producer's CardDefinition.cmc is populated) AND additionally blocked by the pre-existing isZoneFact shape-gate every self-cast producer already hits (every real self-cast fact in the pool carries a real `from:'Hand'`, making it zone-shaped; this card's own event-only cast-sink can structurally only ever match an event-shaped producer under today's matcher — the exact same, already-documented, zero-matches-today situation Venat's own onCastLegendarySpell sink is in, confirmed by re-running find-synergies.mjs: Venat's sink produces 0 real 'cast' matches pool-wide today). Both are real, pre-existing, already-tracked matcher/engine limitations this card's own migration surfaces again, not new discoveries requiring a new writeup.
